title: Positive Airway Pressure (PAP) Devices for the Treatment of Obstructive Sleep Apnea
scope: Initial coverage of a single-level CPAP device (E0601) for obstructive sleep apnea

children.text: In-person clinical evaluation by the treating practitioner for OSA, performed before the sleep test
children.suggestedFix: Attach the dated in-person evaluation note (before the sleep test date) documenting OSA signs/symptoms assessment.

sourceSpan.quote: The beneficiary has an in-person clinical evaluation by the treating practitioner prior to the sleep test to assess the beneficiary for obstructive sleep apnea.

present: {date}: In-person visit for evaluation of suspected obstructive sleep apnea. Reports loud snoring and witnessed apneas; Epworth score 14. Home sleep test ordered.
negated: {date}: Telephone outreach only; patient has not been seen in person for sleep complaints.
contradicted: {date}: First visit for sleep complaints occurred after the sleep study had already been performed.
paraphrased: {date}: Face-to-face assessment for OSA symptoms (snoring, gasping at night) completed prior to arranging diagnostic sleep testing.

children.text: Sleep test AHI or RDI of at least 15 events per hour with a minimum of 30 events
children.suggestedFix: Attach the full sleep study report showing AHI/RDI, total events and recording time.

sourceSpan.quote: The apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) or Respiratory Disturbance Index (RDI) is greater than or equal to 15 events per hour with a minimum of 30 events

present: {date}: Home sleep apnea test report: AHI 23.4 events/hour, 142 total respiratory events over 6.1 hours of recording.
negated: {date}: Sleep study pending; no results available yet.
contradicted: {date}: Home sleep apnea test report: AHI 3.1 events/hour. No significant sleep-disordered breathing.
paraphrased: {date}: Polysomnography shows severe obstructive sleep apnea with an apnea-hypopnea index of 31 per hour (188 events).

children.label: Mild OSA (AHI 5-14) with symptoms or comorbidity

children.text: Sleep test AHI or RDI between 5 and 14 events per hour with a minimum of 10 events

sourceSpan.quote: The AHI or RDI is greater than or equal to 5 and less than or equal to 14 events per hour with a minimum of 10 events

children.text: Documented excessive daytime sleepiness, impaired cognition, mood disorder, or insomnia

sourceSpan.quote: Excessive daytime sleepiness, impaired cognition, mood disorders, or insomnia

children.text: Documented hypertension, ischemic heart disease, or history of stroke

sourceSpan.quote: Hypertension, ischemic heart disease, or history of stroke.

children.text: The sleep test was ordered by the beneficiary's treating practitioner
children.suggestedFix: Attach the sleep test order signed by the treating practitioner.

sourceSpan.quote: The sleep test is ordered by the beneficiary's treating practitioner

present: {date}: Order placed by treating physician: home sleep apnea test (Type III).
negated: {date}: Patient self-referred to a direct-to-consumer sleep test; no practitioner order on file.
contradicted: {date}: Sleep study was ordered by an online vendor without involvement of the treating practitioner.
paraphrased: {date}: Treating physician requested an overnight diagnostic sleep study.

children.text: Beneficiary/caregiver received instruction from the supplier on proper use and care of the device
children.suggestedFix: Attach the DME supplier's setup/education note documenting instruction on device use and care.

sourceSpan.quote: The beneficiary and/or their caregiver has received instruction from the supplier of the device in the proper use and care of the equipment.

present: {date}: DME setup visit: patient instructed on CPAP use, cleaning and mask care; teach-back completed.
negated: {date}: Device shipped to patient; no setup or education visit documented.
contradicted: {date}: Patient declined supplier education and setup.
paraphrased: {date}: Supplier respiratory therapist trained patient and spouse on operating and maintaining the CPAP machine.
